assertions.each_file_or_audit_layer_growth_at_most: source multiplier × 1.3 relative to the 4-document baseline

execution.database: Real local PostgreSQL; separate disposable schema for each scale; schemas dropped after measurement
execution.queue: execute_command invoked directly; this test does not assert Redis delivery or worker crash recovery
execution.source_inputs: Generated DOCX fixtures with distinct obligations and one shared synthetic image; 4, 8, 16 documents

implementation_state: Final compact SourceView, decoded-message budget and streaming regression; deterministic mock, no external model usage
limits: Deterministic contract/storage acceptance only; not real-model semantic acceptance or evidence of provider token usage.
Similar independent documents exercise increasing pack count. Large-single-document planner preparation has separate tests.
Contains only synthetic hashes, counts, sizes, timings and estimates; no original files, source text, images, credentials or raw responses.

measurement_methods.all_artifact_unique_bytes: Sizes of all physical content-addressed files in the isolated run root; each file counted once
measurement_methods.audit_database_bytes: SUM(pg_column_size(row)) for tender_model_requests in the run
measurement_methods.audit_response_unique_bytes: Received synthetic raw response artifacts counted once by hash; audit rows contain pointers
measurement_methods.checkpoint_bytes: SUM(pg_column_size(row)) for checkpoints/checkpoint_blobs/checkpoint_writes in the run thread; excludes indexes, WAL and page allocation
measurement_methods.frozen_unique_bytes: Unique canonical raw, source index, referenced images and frozen document/stage indexes; excludes original files and pack descriptors
measurement_methods.layers: Layer values describe different boundaries and are not additive; all_artifact_unique_bytes is the full file total
measurement_methods.original_unique_bytes: Original artifact sizes once per SHA-256 within each run
measurement_methods.pack_plan_unique_bytes: Unique v2 pack descriptors, aggregate PackPlan index and budget specification; selectors/references without source text/grid/base64
measurement_methods.request_diagnostics: Per-call request_digest, source range dedup counts, body/support UTF8, decoded-message estimate and wire bytes; no source text/images/raw responses
measurement_methods.timings: Measured wall-clock stage duration on shared development hardware; descriptive, not a performance guarantee
